lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Where's the knife that he used to stab her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: In the truck under the seat.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did he show you that knife?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: How do you know that was ............instead of the truck?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: We can't discuss that. How do you know it's in there?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did he take you down and show you the jeep? Did he tell you how he got the jeep down there?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Which way did he drive it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Do you think Chuck knows about this?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did he tell you when he did this?
